The official homepage says the company handles heating, cooling, and ventilation needs, including a routine maintenance check or an emergency repair on a heating or cooling unit, for residential and commercial clients, plus a consultation on system options. It does not publish a furnace-only specialty.

The homepage label SCHEDULE SERVICE links to a Jobber client-hub public work request: https://clienthub.getjobber.com/client_hubs/f1dea92e-dc3b-4174-8e3f-545813006311/public/work_request/new?source=social_media. The link was not submitted.

The homepage has a heading Emergency Service Available and the sentence For emergency service, please contact us at your convenience. It does not publish a 24/7 schedule or a response-time promise.
The homepage has a heading Customer Satisfaction Guaranteed. The paragraph under it does not define a warranty, refund, or labor-coverage term.

Lennox publishes a dealer-locator page for Quality Htg & Air / Quality Heating & Air at 22124 MO-32, Lebanon, Missouri 65536, telephone 417-532-6239, URL matching the official site.
